Remote Bookkeeper

Example Finance GroupRemote (UK)Posted Sep 11, 2026

RemotePart-timeMid LevelDemo listing

About this role

Sample listing for a part-time bookkeeper looking after day-to-day transactions, reconciliations and month-end preparation for a portfolio of small business clients.

Responsibilities

  • Record purchases, sales and expenses in the accounting system
  • Reconcile bank and card accounts weekly
  • Prepare month-end schedules for the accountant
  • Chase missing receipts and client paperwork

Requirements

  • Two or more years of bookkeeping experience
  • Confident with cloud accounting software
  • Understanding of UK VAT basics
  • Discreet handling of confidential financial records

Benefits

  • Choose your own weekly schedule
  • Long-term client portfolio
  • Software licences provided

Skills

BookkeepingReconciliationXeroQuickBooksVAT
